parameters.description: Product name. Must be unique within the company's location bucket, compared trimmed and case-insensitively; a disabled product still holds its name. On update only a changed name or location is checked, so an unchanged product that already shares its name can still be saved. description: Manage activities and products; read conversations and send messages with JobNimbus Engage.

jobnimbus_new_activity_trigger.description: Runs for each new activity in JobNimbus. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

jobnimbus_new_conversation_trigger.description: Runs for each new conversation in JobNimbus. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

jobnimbus_new_message_trigger.description: Runs for each new message in JobNimbus. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

jobnimbus_new_or_updated_activity_trigge.description: Runs for each activity added or changed in JobNimbus. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on start it only when they change. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

jobnimbus_new_or_updated_conversation_tr.description: Runs for each conversation added or changed in JobNimbus. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on start it only when they change. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

jobnimbus_new_or_updated_message_trigger.description: Runs for each message added or changed in JobNimbus. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on start it only when they change. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

jobnimbus_new_or_updated_product_trigger.description: Runs for each product added or changed in JobNimbus. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on start it only when they change. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

jobnimbus_new_product_trigger.description: Runs for each new product in JobNimbus. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.
